ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0036 requires the direct-trust threshold and the bioregional Scale population to remain separate concepts with stated evidence and uncertainty, and the volume-04 voice card lists any population threshold presented as biological law among the known weak passages. Both bear directly on the relational coherence threshold section. CTD-0076 fixes Scale as the singular and ICONS as the plural. CTD-0075 forbids naming a Volume III apparatus, which changed one clause in the scaling chapter's opening.

findings.summary: The threshold claim was correctly bounded by the ledger and the mechanism behind it was removed with it.

evidence.baseline: below a certain threshold, coordination can rely on direct interpersonal trust and embodied relational knowledge, while above that threshold, it requires institutional mechanisms that inevitably introduce their own distortions
evidence.shipped: Direct trust can carry more of the work in a small cohort. Larger populations depend increasingly on roles, records, and formal process.

findings.authorizedBy: CTD-0036, and the volume card's known weak passage on population thresholds presented as biological law.
findings.diagnosis: The bounding is correct and is kept: the shipped provisional and not a biological law framing survives against the baseline's cannot sustain. What the paydown also removed is that the institutional mechanisms introduce their own distortions, which is the cost the whole nesting design exists to minimise. A threshold without a stated cost reads as an administrative fact rather than as a design problem.

findings.summary: The precedent list lost the statement of what it is a list of.

evidence.baseline: This is not a new insight. The federal principle in political architecture, polycentric governance in commons management, subsidiarity in Catholic social teaching, the cellular structure of many durable movement organizations all represent versions of the same design response to the relational coherence threshold.
evidence.shipped: Federalism, polycentric governance, subsidiarity, and cellular movement structures offer precedents for nested coordination.

findings.diagnosis: This is not a new insight is the sentence that keeps the passage from claiming originality, which is exactly the discipline CTD-0078 asks for elsewhere. Naming each precedent's home discipline is also what lets a reader check it. The shipped list of four bare nouns cannot be checked.

findings.summary: Credit, running the other way. The kept closing specification list converts the section's demand for detail into nameable work.

evidence.baseline: Providence's specific application of this principle must be specified in enough detail to guide actual institutional design rather than remaining at the level of architectural philosophy.
evidence.shipped: ...rather than remaining at the level of architectural philosophy, which means specifying membership, representation, delegation, dispute resolution, and accountability across levels.

findings.authorizedBy: R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, recorded in the twenty-rule audit of 2026-07-31.
findings.diagnosis: The baseline ends by demanding specificity it does not supply. The kept clause names the five things a nested design must actually specify, which is the difference between an exhortation and an assignment. Repair of the sentence's emptiness, not bounding of its claim.

debtImpact.note: The threshold is restored in hedged form with the provisional framing and the explicit refusal of a biological law both kept.
The restored bioregional sentence uses Scale as the singular.

reasoning.note: R-LEDGER-WINS. CTD-0036 and the voice card together require the threshold to stay provisional. The baseline's communities significantly above one hundred and fifty people cannot sustain is restored as appear unable to sustain, with the shipped statement that it is not a biological law kept in the same paragraph.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Four em dashes. Three were parenthetical and became comma pairs. One introduced the zone the research converges on and became a colon.
The shipped statement that whether the nesting distinction holds in practice has not been demonstrated, and the shipped list of what must still be specified across levels.
The distortion cost of institutional mechanisms, the planetary scale statement of the design problem, and the precedent list with its disciplines named.

openQuestions: The restored sentence still says the research converges on a zone without naming the research. CTD-0078 requires the source register this volume does not have. Restored and flagged rather than sourced, since sourcing is outside an editorial pass.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. Same shape as the first community's size argument: the ledger disputes a number, the pass removed the number's mechanism, and the restoration separates them. Two sections in one part with the same failure is enough to treat it as the volume's characteristic form of overpaydown.

audits.auditor: editorial-agent, generation 1 of the twenty-rule re-render lane
audits.scope: Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the section is a restoration, not a substitution, and the pairing test applies. Verbatim survival understates fidelity here: every R-PUNCT-STRUCT repair and recorded bounding changes the sentence it lands in, so the non-surviving remainder was read against the diff and attributed rather than assumed lost.

audits.checked: R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: the CTD-0036 boundings were verified at width, cannot sustain restored as appear unable to sustain, the biological-law refusal inserted beside the precision hedge, and the nesting caveat appended to the design solution; the mechanism prose around each is baseline. This section is inside CTD-0036's author-reserved question and the audit changes nothing in it. R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the design solution keeps its committing half, build the architecture through nested communities, beside the kept hedge that the distinction has not been demonstrated. R-PAIRED-DELETION: the one hundred and fifty zone, direct trust, and nesting recur in What the First Community Requires and The First Scale, all three ends carrying the same provisional frame. R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK, R-REFRAIN-COST, R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: The restoration holds under the full twenty-rule index. Three of eight baseline sentences survive verbatim, the low count fully explained by the CTD-0036 boundings threaded through nearly every sentence; each was verified in place against the item's scope. One substitution credit recorded as F3. No prose change required.
